items.t: Rust in rocker panels, wheel arches and frame rails
items.job: Cut out and weld in rocker or frame rail repair sections
items.note: Surface rust treatment costs far less. Severe frame rail rust can make the car not worth repairing.

items.t: Radiator plastic tank cracks and leaks coolant
items.job: Replace radiator and coolant
items.note: Owners report $140-$1,000 depending on what else was damaged.

items.t: Coolant expansion tank cracks
items.job: Replace coolant expansion tank and refill coolant
items.note: Aluminum aftermarket tanks cost more but last longer. Owners report $250-$500 total.

items.t: Rod bearing failure on early 2.0L engines
items.job: Replace engine with used or rebuilt unit
items.note: Owners report $3,500-$5,800.

items.t: Manual transmission grinds or won't go into 2nd or 3rd
items.job: Replace 6-speed manual transmission
items.note: Covered under the powertrain warranty for eligible cars per TSB 05-001/17; hours are the TSB labor time.

items.t: Clutch master or slave cylinder leaks
items.job: Replace clutch master and/or slave cylinder and bleed
items.note: YourMechanic averages about $233 for the master cylinder alone.

items.t: Water in the cabin or trunk from clogged top drains
items.job: Clear top drains and replace drain valves or seals
items.note: Owners report $20-$378.

items.t: Soft top cracks, tears or wears through
items.job: Replace convertible soft top
items.note: Aftermarket tops cost about $600-$1,000 plus installation.

items.t: Power retractable hardtop stops working
items.job: Repair hardtop switches, motor or gears
items.note: Switch repairs are cheap; owners report $200-$1,400 for motor or gear repairs.

items.t: Thermostat failure
items.job: Replace thermostat and refill coolant
items.note: Owners report $30-$400.

items.t: Cam angle sensor failure causes stalling
items.job: Replace cam angle sensor and O-ring

items.t: Oil leaks from valve cover and seals
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket
items.note: Rear main seal leaks cost much more because the transmission comes out.

items.t: Timing belt due for replacement
items.job: Replace timing belt, water pump and seals

items.t: Ignition coil failure causes misfires
items.job: Replace ignition coil and plug wires
items.note: Owners report $200-$500.

items.t: Fuel pump failure
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump
items.note: Owners report $166-$600.

items.t: Battery drains while parked
items.job: Parasitic draw test and battery replacement

items.t: A/C compressor failure
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, dryer and recharge
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $1,200.

items.t: A/C stops cooling from a cracked A/C line
items.job: Replace A/C line and recharge system
items.note: The line is about $90; recharging adds to the cost.

items.t: Infotainment screen cracks or delaminates
items.job: Replace infotainment screen or touch panel
items.note: Owners were quoted about $1,200 at the dealer; aftermarket screens are much cheaper.

items.t: Paint chips easily on the hood and front
items.job: Touch up paint or repaint front panels
items.note: Touch-up is cheap; repainting the hood and bumper costs much more.

items.t: Clear coat peeling
items.job: Sand and repaint affected panels
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $1,800.

items.t: Power window motor or regulator failure
items.job: Replace window regulator and motor
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $305-$394.

items.t: Blind spot monitor sensor faults
items.job: Replace blind-spot radar sensor
items.note: Often covered under warranty or a service bulletin on 2016-2017 cars.

items.t: Headlight system malfunction warning
items.job: Diagnose adaptive headlight system
items.note: Usually warranty work on these years; a headlight assembly costs much more out of warranty.

items.t: Horn cover can come loose when the airbag deploys (recall)
items.job: Replace driver airbag module
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Fog light socket can fall out and overheat (recall)
items.job: Install fog light socket retaining spring
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Automatic may downshift suddenly (recall)
items.job: Reprogram transmission control module
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Underbody skid plate may fall off (recall)
items.job: Replace skid plate
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace low-pressure fuel pump
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Front airbags may deploy too forcefully (recall)
items.job: Update airbag control module software
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Stability control warning light may not work (recall)
items.job: Replace DSC unit
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Ticking noise from the valve lifters
items.job: Oil and filter change (lifter replacement if needed)
items.note: An oil change often cures it; replacing the lifters is a bigger job.

items.t: Immobilizer failure prevents starting
items.job: Diagnose and replace or reprogram immobilizer module
items.note: Owners report about $600. Parts are getting scarce.

items.t: Clutch shudder when pulling away cold
items.job: Replace clutch disc, pressure plate and release bearing
items.note: Owners report $350-$1,000 for clutch replacement.
